2.6.evidence:
CHAPTER X
GUIDANCE AND SUPERVISION
Article 28
(1) Regional Government is obligated to conduct guidance and supervision of the implementation of Protection of Women and Children from acts of violence.
(2) Guidance and Supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) includes:
a. coordination;
b. guidance;
c. education and training; and
d. monitoring and evaluation.
(3) Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (2) in order to realize the objectives of Protection of Women and Children from acts of violence in accordance with laws and regulations.
(4) Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (3) shall be conducted with professional and transparent principles.
(5) Regional Apparatus shall report periodically to the Regent regarding the implementation of Protection of Women Victims and Children involved in acts of violence.
2.6.rationale: The policy explicitly includes monitoring and evaluation within guidance and supervision obligations, and requires periodic reporting to the Regent on implementation.

3.1.evidence:
Article 21
(1) Protection services for Women and Children from acts of violence can be implemented by UPTD PPA.
(2) As long as UPTD PPA has not been established, the duties and functions of protection services for Women and Children from acts of violence shall be implemented by Regional Apparatus and related Institutions in an integrated and continuous manner.
(3) Protection Services as referred to in paragraph (1) may be delegated by UPTD PPA to other service units through networking and cooperation.
(4) Cooperation as referred to in paragraph (2) shall be set forth in the form of a cooperation agreement.
3.1.rationale: The policy states that protection services for women and children from violence can be implemented by UPTD PPA, and provides for integrated implementation by regional apparatus/institutions if UPTD PPA is not yet established, indicating an integrated service unit/framework.

3.3.rationale: The policy explicitly includes "complaint services" as a form of service provided to victims, indicating a service function for receiving reports/complaints of violence.

3.4.evidence:

(1) The Shelter House as referred to in Article 11 paragraph (1) provides temporary place and/or shelter for victims of violence until their rights are restored.
(2) The organization and/or management of the Shelter House as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be implemented by the relevant Regional Apparatus.
(3) For security purposes and upon request of women victims of violence and children involved in acts of violence, the manager or organizer of the Shelter House as referred to in paragraph (2) may place the person concerned in a certain place that is kept confidential.

(1) Regional Government is obligated to:
